Body.Content:
This feature will allow admins to create the right set of compatibility, inclusion and exclusion rules, withing a single composite product to ensure the right set of products get bundled together. Based on the configured rules, the seller will receive relevant guidance while configuring a composite product for the customer to ensure an accurate product offering is provided to the customer. The scop of the rules will be at a single quote line relevant to a composite product.

GA date: March CY2027
